intro: Admiral Proudmoore's Orders are written battle plans recovered from Kul Tiras forces entrenching themselves along the coastline of Durotar. Penned before the Grand Admiral's defeat at Theramore, the documents outline persistent military strategies that continue to threaten the nascent orc homeland.

p: Even after the death of Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore at Theramore, his expeditionary forces refuse to yield. Recovered from Lieutenant Benedict's garrison at Tiragarde Keep, these tactical directives detail long-term maneuvers and fortifications designed to undermine the Horde. The orders prove that the Grand Admiral's offensive in Durotar was no hasty raid, but an organized campaign structured to endure long past his own demise. For the Horde, the recovered documents offer vital insight into Kul Tiras operations and potential reinforcements threatening their borders.
